headline: Preliminary findings of the PAK-SEHAT heart study, presented at the 55th CardioCon in Islamabad, found calcium deposits in the coronary arteries of 26 percent of 2,000 apparently healthy Pakistani adults with no heart symptoms, Arab News reports.

card.desc: 2,000 afraad mein se 26% ki dil ki naliyon mein calcium mila

caption:
Bazahir sehatmand 26% logon ki dil ki naliyon mein calcium mila! ❤️
Arab News ke mutabiq Pakistan ki PAK-SEHAT heart study mein 2,000 aise afraad ka mua'ina kiya gaya jin mein dil ki bimari ki koi alamat nahi thi, phir bhi 26% ki dil ki naliyon (coronary arteries) mein calcium paya gaya. Study ke mutabiq 78% mein motapa, 33% mein high blood pressure aur 22% mein diabetes thi. Yeh ibtidai nataij Saturday ko Islamabad mein 55th CardioCon mein pesh kiye gaye. Researchers ke mutabiq calcium ka matlab lazmi taur par naali band hona ya heart attack nahi hota, aur in logon ko 5 saal tak dekha jayega.
Aap ne aakhri baar apna blood pressure kab check karwaya tha? Comment mein batayein 👇
